sources.title: Tatoeba
sources.attribution: Tatoeba sentence contributors; sentence ids remain traceable to tatoeba.org

audit.note: Tatoeba textual exports are CC BY 2.0 FR, with a separate CC0 subset. Catalogue v2 prefers sentences_detailed.csv so contributor names can be retained when present. Audio is out of scope.

sources.title: WikiMatrix
sources.attribution: Wikipedia contributors; WikiMatrix by Schwenk et al.; extraction and filtering changes by ikna

audit.note: The upstream WikiMatrix README distributes the mined data under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike; ELG records the v1 distribution specifically as CC BY-SA 4.0. The alignment score is retained so the later quality sieve can choose a threshold.

sources.title: Global Voices
sources.attribution: Global Voices plus the credited article/translation contributors and canonical article URL

audit.note: Global Voices publishes reusable text under CC BY and requires source/author credit. The v2018q4 OPUS aligned text is accepted only together with record-level attribution recovered from the underlying articles or an equivalent trustworthy sidecar.

sources.title: MASSIVE 1.1
sources.attribution: MASSIVE by Amazon; cite FitzGerald et al. (2022) and SLURP as requested by the upstream dataset documentation

audit.note: MASSIVE 1.1 is a 52-language parallel localization dataset. The upstream dataset card identifies the data license as CC BY 4.0 and the official repository documents stable per-locale JSONL files plus shared SLURP ids. It remains an ikna publication candidate until Part 6 manual quality review is accepted.
